import importlib.util,json,re
from pathlib import Path
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('c6_publish_progress',Path('tools/progress.py').resolve())
p=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(p)
old_source=p.git('show','2ddf83de7a89da608e8267a21313d64b373bf5e2:tools/progress.py').decode()
old_path=re.search(r"^PR2_IMPORT_MANIFEST = '([^']+)'$",old_source,re.M).group(1)
old=json.loads(p.git('show','2ddf83de7a89da608e8267a21313d64b373bf5e2:'+old_path))
new=json.loads(p.git('show','c00ae5e766f71defbaf2894bac20b2ea7e93a1de:'+p.PR2_IMPORT_MANIFEST))
assert len(old['commits'])==17 and len(new['commits'])==18
assert old['commits']==new['commits'][:17], 'old17_records_differ'
assert new['commits'][-1]['commit']=='b6bc0396bb7d53359d23b806a3177edc194c8e62'
assert p.PR2_IMPORT_COMMITS[-1]=='b6bc0396bb7d53359d23b806a3177edc194c8e62'
print('PASS: JSON old17 == new first17; new total18; only final commit b6bc0396',flush=True)
p.verify_import('b6bc0396bb7d53359d23b806a3177edc194c8e62',manifest_ref='c00ae5e766f71defbaf2894bac20b2ea7e93a1de')
print('PR2_IMPORT_DELTA_VERIFIED old17_identical + b6_real_blobs',flush=True)
